source_context: NRC Event Notification 58200: EOF lost normal and alternate electrical power; backup generator unsuccessful; compensatory measures established
evidence_question: What caused the alternate/backup generator failure to run, and when was the root cause determined?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: root-cause report or corrective-action record with event date, failure mode, owner, approval/disposition state, and hashable artifact copy
blocks_claim: EOF availability; emergency response facility power resilience; EOC/EOF/JIC operations demonstrated
next_action: Request repair/root-cause/CAP package and link to proofcut ledger

evidence_question: When was normal power restored and when was the EOF returned to fully available status?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: restoral log, facility status notification, maintenance record, or operator/corrective action artifact showing timestamp and authority basis
blocks_claim: EOF restored before exercise; EOF available for evaluated response

evidence_question: Were compensatory EOF-location measures actually activated, drilled, or evaluated after the power-loss event?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: compensatory-measure procedure excerpt, activation checklist, staffing roster, controller/evaluator note, or drill/exercise product with scope limits
blocks_claim: compensatory measures adequate; alternate EOF route demonstrated

evidence_question: Did the June 2026 evaluated exercise include EOF operations under normal power, restored power, or degraded/alternate facility conditions?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: exercise extent-of-play, objective coverage matrix, evaluator log, or AAR/IP objective disposition that names EOF/facility/power assumptions
blocks_claim: exercise evaluated EOF-power recovery; exercise evaluated degraded EOF operations
next_action: Add to June 12 public-meeting capture questions

evidence_question: Were assessment and communications functions available during the compensatory mode promised in the notification?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: communications test logs, JIC/EOF product timestamps, WebEOC/phone/radio logs, equipment checklists, or evaluator observations

source_context: NRC Event Notification 58200 and NRC/FEMA exercise-participant context
evidence_question: Did offsite EOCs/JICs know about or exercise against the EOF degraded-power condition?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: state/county controller logs, injects, situation reports, JIC records, or evaluation notes connecting offsite organizations to the EOF status assumption
blocks_claim: offsite organizations integrated with EOF contingency
next_action: Ask whether EOF degraded-power status was in scope

evidence_question: Was backup-generator retest completed under load or otherwise acceptance-tested after repair?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: maintenance work order, generator test record, load/functional test result, acceptance criteria, and deficiency closure status

evidence_question: Was the loss of emergency assessment capability reviewed for reportability, extent-of-condition, and recurrence prevention?
minimum_admissible_artifacts: 10 CFR 50.72/50.73 follow-up, LER if applicable, CAP action, extent-of-condition review, recurrence-prevention action, or NRC inspection follow-up
next_action: Track NRC/ADAMS and licensee corrective action follow-up
